# Chimera Copilot instructions

- Read [the product charter](../CHIMERA_CHARTER.md) before substantive design or
  coding, and follow [repository agent guidance](../AGENTS.md).
- Inspect existing implementation before proposing replacements. State how a
  proposed feature supports the charter; surface conflicts for founder review
  rather than silently changing direction. Preserve compatible delivery guidance.
- Preserve unrelated working-tree modifications and the classic application.
- Verify functionality and real usability. Report automated checks separately
  from human review; successful tests never establish founder acceptance.
- Work locally first in `C:\inetpub\Chimera2`. Require explicit authorization for
  merging, migration, deployment and paid generation, and explicit founder approval
  for charter amendments, including major changes.
- Stop for founder review before committing the initial charter and instructions;
  commit only with explicit authorization.
